content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Biscuit is a gentle dry baked snack specially formulated for children aged 6 months to 3 years. It is made from whole grains, contains no added sugar or artificial flavors, making it safe and easy to digest.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Produced using low‑temperature baking to preserve maximum nutrients.
Contains whole oat flakes, rice flour and a small amount of fruit puree for natural sweetness.
Gluten‑free, suitable for children with gluten sensitivity.
One serving (30 g) provides about 120 kcal, convenient for portion control.
The biscuit dissolves easily in the mouth, reducing choking risk for young kids.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Whole grains deliver sustained energy and help maintain stable blood sugar levels.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 support nervous system development and metabolism.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: Iron is essential for hemoglobin formation and helps prevent anemia in children.

items.title: Natural antioxidants
items.content: Fruit puree (e.g., apple) provides vitamin C and polyphenols that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: A modest amount of dietary fiber promotes a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Grain allergy
items.content: Children with known allergies to wheat, rice or oats should consult a pediatrician before introducing the product.

items.title: Portion control
items.content: Excessive consumption may lead to unwanted weight gain due to the biscuit’s caloric content.

items.title: Choking hazard
items.content: Despite its soft texture, infants under 12 months should be offered the biscuit under supervision.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The biscuit can be served as a standalone snack, softened in milk, baby juice or water. It also works well mixed into porridge, yogurt or fruit puree for added variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in the original packaging in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly or transfer to an airtight container. Shelf life: 12 months.
